scenario: Logical lifetime is a schema-level property per LLOG.11.1 — `emit X logical` requires X declared `logical`, and `emit X` without the `logical` keyword on a logical-declared schema is also a compile error. LFAC.1.2.5 covers the `logical-keyword on ttl-schema` direction; this pins the converse: missing the keyword on a logical schema is a DS_VALIDATE_BAD_LIFECYCLE_FLAG. Authors cannot accidentally mix lifecycle classes either way.
rules_ds:
schema Sig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Sig s where s.v == 1
->
    emit Sig v: 99
